source_text: Don’t worry, Chloe, I got you.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp#>.Don’t worry, Chloe, I got you.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp#>.Don’t worry, Chloe, I got you."

translation: Spokojnie, Chloe, mam cię.

source_text: Don’t let go!

structure.raw_value: ChShCl.Don’t let go!
structure.script_literal: "ChShCl.Don’t let go!"

translation: Nie puszczaj!

source_text: Reach for me. I’ll pull you up.

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp.Reach for me. I’ll pull you up.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp.Reach for me. I’ll pull you up."

translation: Podaj mi rękę. Wyciągnę cię.

source_text: Thank you for rescuing me.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp#.Thank you for rescuing me.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp#.Thank you for rescuing me."

translation: Dziękuję, że mnie uratowałeś.

source_text: What were you doing up here?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What were you doing up here?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What were you doing up here?"

translation: Co tu robiłaś?

source_text: I was just coming up to… pray.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx.I was just coming up to… pray.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx.I was just coming up to… pray."

translation: Przyszłam tu tylko… się pomodlić.

source_text: Please don’t tell Father Solomon you came up here…

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Please don’t tell Father Solomon you came up here…
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Please don’t tell Father Solomon you came up here…"

translation: Proszę, nie mów ojcu Solomonowi, że tu przyszłam…

source_text: He doesn’t like people wandering around the church.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.He doesn’t like people wandering around the church.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.He doesn’t like people wandering around the church."

translation: Nie lubi, kiedy ludzie włóczą się po kościele.

source_text: I’m sorry. It’s just… I wanted to be alone.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I’m sorry. It’s just… I wanted to be alone.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I’m sorry. It’s just… I wanted to be alone."

translation: Przepraszam. Po prostu… chciałam pobyć sama.

source_text: This is my fault. I didn’t mean to startle you earlier, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.This is my fault. I didn’t mean to startle you earlier, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.This is my fault. I didn’t mean to startle you earlier, Chloe."

translation: To moja wina. Nie chciałem cię wcześniej przestraszyć, Chloe.

source_text: We must fix the broken chandelier. I will go and inform Father that maintenance is required.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.We must fix the broken chandelier. I will go and inform Father that maintenance is required.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.We must fix the broken chandelier. I will go and inform Father that maintenance is required."

translation: Musimy naprawić zepsuty żyrandol. Pójdę powiedzieć ojcu, że trzeba go naprawić.

source_text: I’ll come down in a bit. I want to speak with Chloe, alone.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll come down in a bit. I want to speak with Chloe, alone.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll come down in a bit. I want to speak with Chloe, alone."

translation: Zaraz zejdę. Chcę porozmawiać z Chloe na osobności.

source_text: Very well. Please be careful up here.

structure.raw_value: JuBaOp.Very well. Please be careful up here.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaOp.Very well. Please be careful up here."

translation: Dobrze. Uważajcie tutaj na górze.

source_text: Why do you want to talk to me, alone?

structure.raw_value: ChBaOp#.Why do you want to talk to me, alone?
structure.script_literal: "ChBaOp#.Why do you want to talk to me, alone?"

translation: Czemu chcesz ze mną porozmawiać na osobności?

source_text: You know why, Chloe. I messed up.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.You know why, Chloe. I messed up.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.You know why, Chloe. I messed up."

translation: Wiesz dlaczego, Chloe. Popełniłem błąd.

source_text: You’re free to live your life, 1Hero. It’s Hannah who screwed things up.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.You’re free to live your life, 1Hero. It’s Hannah who screwed things up.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.You’re free to live your life, 1Hero. It’s Hannah who screwed things up."

translation: Możesz żyć, jak chcesz, 1Hero. To Hannah wszystko skomplikowała.

source_text: We can hardly blame Hannah for being Hannah.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.We can hardly blame Hannah for being Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.We can hardly blame Hannah for being Hannah."

translation: Trudno winić Hannah za to, że jest sobą.

source_text: I’m worried about you, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.I’m worried about you, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.I’m worried about you, Chloe."

translation: Martwię się o ciebie, Chloe.

source_text: I appreciate that you care for me. You are like a big brother.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.I appreciate that you care for me. You are like a big brother.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.I appreciate that you care for me. You are like a big brother."

translation: Doceniam, że się o mnie troszczysz. Jesteś dla mnie jak starszy brat.

source_text: If that’s how you feel, then you can come to me with any problems you have.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.If that’s how you feel, then you can come to me with any problems you have.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.If that’s how you feel, then you can come to me with any problems you have."

translation: Skoro tak czujesz, możesz przyjść do mnie z każdym problemem.

source_text: I really like it here, 1Hero. Sister Judy has helped me a lot over the years.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.I really like it here, 1Hero. Sister Judy has helped me a lot over the years.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.I really like it here, 1Hero. Sister Judy has helped me a lot over the years."

translation: Bardzo mi się tu podoba, 1Hero. Siostra Judy przez lata bardzo mi pomagała.

source_text: I felt so guilty for leaving school early. But it wasn’t what I wanted.

structure.raw_value: ChSaEx.I felt so guilty for leaving school early. But it wasn’t what I wanted.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaEx.I felt so guilty for leaving school early. But it wasn’t what I wanted."

translation: Miałam ogromne wyrzuty sumienia, że wcześnie rzuciłam szkołę. Ale to nie było to, czego chciałam.

source_text: You’ll find your way. You’re still young.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You’ll find your way. You’re still young.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You’ll find your way. You’re still young."

translation: Znajdziesz swoją drogę. Wciąż jesteś młoda.

source_text: I want to show you something.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I want to show you something.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I want to show you something."

translation: Chcę ci coś pokazać.

source_text: Wow! Now this is a view.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp#>.Wow! Now this is a view.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp#>.Wow! Now this is a view."

translation: Wow! Ale widok!

source_text: Isn’t it wonderful? Casula forest is so beautiful this time of year.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Isn’t it wonderful? Casula forest is so beautiful this time of year.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Isn’t it wonderful? Casula forest is so beautiful this time of year."

translation: Prawda, że wspaniale? Las Casula jest o tej porze roku przepiękny.

source_text: I can see why you come here to think.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can see why you come here to think.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can see why you come here to think."

translation: Rozumiem, czemu przychodzisz tu pomyśleć.

source_text: I feel conflicted, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.I feel conflicted, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.I feel conflicted, 1Hero."

translation: Mam mętlik w głowie, 1Hero.

source_text: I let Mom down… She wanted me to go to SDU, and I threw it away.

structure.raw_value: ChSaEx.I let Mom down… She wanted me to go to SDU, and I threw it away.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaEx.I let Mom down… She wanted me to go to SDU, and I threw it away."

translation: Zawiodłam mamę… Chciała, żebym poszła na SDU, a ja to zaprzepaściłam.

source_text: She’s supportive of you. If it’s not for you, then you’re making the right choice.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’s supportive of you. If it’s not for you, then you’re making the right choice.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’s supportive of you. If it’s not for you, then you’re making the right choice."

translation: Wspiera cię. Jeśli to nie dla ciebie, podejmujesz właściwą decyzję.

source_text: Is she, 1Hero? Sometimes I wish she would act her age.

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Is she, 1Hero? Sometimes I wish she would act her age.
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Is she, 1Hero? Sometimes I wish she would act her age."

translation: Naprawdę, 1Hero? Czasem chciałabym, żeby zachowywała się stosownie do swojego wieku.

source_text: She loves you, Chloe. You know that.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She loves you, Chloe. You know that.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She loves you, Chloe. You know that."

translation: Kocha cię, Chloe. Wiesz o tym.

source_text: What am I going to do with my life?

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.What am I going to do with my life?
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.What am I going to do with my life?"

translation: Co mam zrobić ze swoim życiem?

source_text: You’re still young, you’ll figure it out.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You’re still young, you’ll figure it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You’re still young, you’ll figure it out."

translation: Jesteś jeszcze młoda, jakoś to sobie poukładasz.

source_text: You think I’m young?

structure.raw_value: ChBaDe.You think I’m young?
structure.script_literal: "ChBaDe.You think I’m young?"

translation: Uważasz, że jestem młoda?

source_text: When you were my age, you knew exactly what you wanted to do.

structure.raw_value: ChBaEx.When you were my age, you knew exactly what you wanted to do.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaEx.When you were my age, you knew exactly what you wanted to do."

translation: Kiedy byłeś w moim wieku, dokładnie wiedziałeś, co chcesz robić.

source_text: Well.. I mean…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Well.. I mean…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Well.. I mean…"

translation: Cóż… To znaczy…

source_text: You wanted to find your father.

structure.raw_value: ChBaDe.You wanted to find your father.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaDe.You wanted to find your father."

translation: Chciałeś odnaleźć swojego ojca.

source_text: That’s true… What drives you?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That’s true… What drives you?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That’s true… What drives you?"

translation: To prawda… A co ciebie napędza?

source_text: Think deep and hard. That is where you’ll find your answer.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Think deep and hard. That is where you’ll find your answer.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Think deep and hard. That is where you’ll find your answer."

translation: Zastanów się porządnie. Tam znajdziesz odpowiedź.

source_text: Maybe I’ll become a nun.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Maybe I’ll become a nun.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Maybe I’ll become a nun."

translation: Może zostanę zakonnicą.

source_text: No! Silly.

structure.raw_value: ChFlOpNo3.No! Silly.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOpNo3.No! Silly."

translation: Nie! Głuptasie.

source_text: You’ll figure it out, Chloe. I believe in you.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You’ll figure it out, Chloe. I believe in you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You’ll figure it out, Chloe. I believe in you."

translation: Sama to rozgryziesz, Chloe. Wierzę w ciebie.

source_text: Chloe… I have something I need to tell you.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Chloe… I have something I need to tell you.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Chloe… I have something I need to tell you."

translation: Chloe… Muszę ci coś powiedzieć.

source_text: A long time ago… I had a big crush on you.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.A long time ago… I had a big crush on you.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.A long time ago… I had a big crush on you."

translation: Dawno temu… byłem w tobie zakochany po uszy.

source_text: I know. Hannah told me.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I know. Hannah told me.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I know. Hannah told me."

translation: Wiem. Hannah mi powiedziała.

source_text: I would have said something, but…

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I would have said something, but…
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I would have said something, but…"

translation: Powiedziałbym ci, ale…

source_text: I was too young.

structure.raw_value: ChFrDe.I was too young.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrDe.I was too young."

translation: Byłam za młoda.

source_text: It took me a while to let that go…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It took me a while to let that go…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It took me a while to let that go…"

translation: Trochę mi zajęło, zanim się z tym pogodziłem…

source_text: And when you came back, I just couldn’t feel the same…

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.And when you came back, I just couldn’t feel the same…
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.And when you came back, I just couldn’t feel the same…"

translation: A kiedy wróciłaś, nie potrafiłem już czuć tego samego…

source_text: I didn’t let myself feel the same.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.I didn’t let myself feel the same.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.I didn’t let myself feel the same."

translation: Nie pozwoliłem sobie znów tak poczuć.

source_text: We can’t change the past. I’m just glad we stayed friends.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.We can’t change the past. I’m just glad we stayed friends.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.We can’t change the past. I’m just glad we stayed friends."

translation: Nie zmienimy przeszłości. Cieszę się, że zostaliśmy przyjaciółmi.

source_text: I shouldn’t have called you young earlier. You’ve grown into a beautiful woman.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I shouldn’t have called you young earlier. You’ve grown into a beautiful woman.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I shouldn’t have called you young earlier. You’ve grown into a beautiful woman."

translation: Nie powinienem był wcześniej mówić, że jesteś młoda. Wyrosłaś na piękną kobietę.

source_text: You’re not bad yourself.

structure.raw_value: ChFlOp.You’re not bad yourself.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOp.You’re not bad yourself."

translation: Ty też niczego sobie.

source_text: Your new girlfriend is really pretty, 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx#.Your new girlfriend is really pretty, 1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx#.Your new girlfriend is really pretty, 1Hero…"

translation: Twoja nowa dziewczyna jest naprawdę ładna, 1Hero…

source_text: I don’t want to mess that up.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.I don’t want to mess that up.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.I don’t want to mess that up."

translation: Nie chcę tego zepsuć.

source_text: Erica?... She’s helping me with…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Erica?... She’s helping me with…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Erica?... She’s helping me with…"

translation: Erica?... Ona pomaga mi…

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. We can’t change the past, but we can control the future.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.Come on, 1Hero. We can’t change the past, but we can control the future.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.Come on, 1Hero. We can’t change the past, but we can control the future."

translation: No już, 1Hero. Nie zmienimy przeszłości, ale możemy decydować o przyszłości.

source_text: Just promise me you’ll always be here for me.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Just promise me you’ll always be here for me.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Just promise me you’ll always be here for me."

translation: Obiecaj tylko, że zawsze będziesz przy mnie.

source_text: Of course, Chloe. You and Heather mean the world to me.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Of course, Chloe. You and Heather mean the world to me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Of course, Chloe. You and Heather mean the world to me."

translation: Oczywiście, Chloe. Ty i Heather jesteście dla mnie najważniejsze.

source_text: We better get back downstairs before Father Solomon gets super angry.

structure.raw_value: ChFlOp.We better get back downstairs before Father Solomon gets super angry.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOp.We better get back downstairs before Father Solomon gets super angry."

translation: Lepiej wracajmy na dół, zanim ojciec Solomon naprawdę się wścieknie.

source_text: He doesn’t seem like the type to get angry.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.He doesn’t seem like the type to get angry.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.He doesn’t seem like the type to get angry."

translation: Nie wygląda na kogoś, kto łatwo się złości.

source_text: I was joking. Once you get to know Brian and Judy, you’ll understand the joke.

structure.raw_value: ChFlEx.I was joking. Once you get to know Brian and Judy, you’ll understand the joke.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlEx.I was joking. Once you get to know Brian and Judy, you’ll understand the joke."

translation: Żartowałam. Jak poznasz Briana i Judy, zrozumiesz, o co chodzi.

source_text: Okay, I’ll take your word on that.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Okay, I’ll take your word on that.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Okay, I’ll take your word on that."

translation: Dobrze, wierzę ci na słowo.
